what: The Bopl ability pool the player drafts from, one card per round alongside the normal 9 Kings draft. Every name and description resolves at runtime from the player's installed Bopl Battle (boplRef); effects are the mashup's translation of Bopl's mechanics onto 9 Kings' grid battlefield.

rows.gridEffect: Pulls all enemy units within 2 tiles one tile toward its center at battle start
Lobs onto a tile: 8 damage to that tile and knockback 1 tile outward to all units adjacent
Enemy units skip their next attack action entirely
Target enemy unit deals half attack and counts half mass toward knockback resistance for the battle
Shoves every unit in one chosen lane one tile toward the battlefield edge (theirs and yours; your Azure mass protects yours)
Your units in a chosen 2x2 area cannot be targeted by ranged attacks for one round
Tethers the nearest enemy unit in place for one round and drags it 1 tile toward your side when it breaks free
Strikes one enemy unit anywhere on the field for 6 damage and knockback 1 tile
